name: memory_consolidation_pairs
description: Labelled pairs of observations for the consolidation gate. 'existing' is stored first; 'incoming' is then consolidated against it. expected: reinforce (same fact), supersede (same slot, new value), distinct (must remain two memories). false_merge_rate counts every 'distinct' pair that was merged/reinforced/superseded.
